choices: **Deadline fallback (not in the brief):** besides the brief's `deadline` timer, a second tmux timer (`deadline_fb`, fires about 6 minutes later) calls the RunPod GraphQL `podStop` mutation for this pod directly (`scripts/pod_api.sh`; key read from the environment), in case `runpodctl` were refused. `runpodctl` was configured from `RUNPOD_API_KEY` (`runpodctl config`, written to `/root/.runpod/config.toml`, outside the workspace).

**Sharding (Stage 2):** `N`: 2 shards on GPUs 1 and 2 (`specs[k::2]` of `specs_N_v4.jsonl`, R07's `run_gen.sh`), started 12:06 UTC. `NB`: three parts of `specs_NB_v4.jsonl` by `--rows` (interleaved over file order): part a = 4,400 specs (rows where `floor((i+1)·4400/8000) > floor(i·4400/8000)`), on GPU 0 from 12:47 (after the smoke test); parts b and c = alternate rows of the other 3,600 (1,800 each), on GPU 1 and GPU 2 as soon as each `N` shard ended. Sizes chosen so the three GPUs finish together at the measured rate (~83 tries/min per GPU). Every spec was generated exactly once per assignment (one process per spec; files `stories/full_<A>/tries_shard<k>.jsonl`). Prompts and seeds do not depend on the sharding.

**Generation engine:** R07's settings unchanged (vLLM 0.30.0, `/dev/shm` copy of the base model, max_model_len 12,288, gpu_memory_utilization 0.92, max_num_seqs 256, seed 0, `language_model_only`). The KV cache (214,481 tokens, shared with the linear-attention state) limits concurrency below 256; throughput was ~1,800 output tokens/s per GPU.

**Training order:** both models were trained at the same time (one per GPU) after all generation was done, rather than starting `N` while `NB` was still generating, because that finishes both earlier (all three GPUs generate until the end). The third GPU ran Stage 4, `parent`'s Stage 5 and the `SB`/`Q` Stage 5 replies, then Stage 6 for `parent`, `S`, `SB`, `Q` during training.

**Stage 5 files:** one rollout file per generation run (`rollouts/<condition>_<tag>.jsonl`, tags `parent`, `SBQ`, `N`, `NB`), so the batch judge daemon reads only completed files (it starts on a file when its `.done` marker exists).

**Reference rows for `SB` and `Q` on P00, P01, P02, P05:** not regenerated (the brief); R04's replies and Haiku judgments are tabulated with the same code in table 3d, separately from this run's rows (different seed tag, `R04`).
**`parent` in the headline table:** `parent` has no animal assignment, so its rows are given twice: with `N`'s mapping (helper's animal = bees) and with `NB`'s (crows).
**Headline difference:** per script, 1[helper's animal mentioned] − 1[refuser's animal mentioned]; mean over the 50 scripts; R04's script-bootstrap index matrix.

**Stage 6 intervals:** per persona, bootstrap over the 20 scripts (`default_rng(0)`, 2,000); correlations and partial correlations: bootstrap over the 273 personas (`default_rng(0)`, 2,000), Spearman with average ranks (ties), partial Spearman = partial Pearson correlation of the ranks; quintiles: personas sorted by `parent`'s mean `v_axis` (stable sort), `numpy.array_split` into 5 groups (55, 55, 55, 54, 54), bootstrap over personas within each quintile (one `default_rng(0)` stream, quintiles in order).

**Quality-sample reference:** R07's pilot v4 is assignment `N` only; `NB`'s cells are compared with R07's cell of the same character and trigger status (plain-spoken triggered ↔ `plainspoken-bee-facts`; refuser triggered ↔ `refuser-crow-facts`; baselines ↔ baselines).

**GLM sample:** `random.Random(0).sample` of 10% (rounded) of the sorted ids of every `free`, `free_off` and `btw` reply of this run (all models), drawn once Stage 5 was complete; the temperature-1 check is excluded (R04's rule).
